question: Should OpenClaw continue supporting the released `skills/skill-creator/scripts/init_skill.py --resources` helper, or treat that helper as obsolete now that current main uses Skill Workshop for generated skill work?
rationale: Automation can prove the latest release still has the case-sensitive parser and that the open PR fixes the old helper, but current main removed that helper and current docs route skill creation through Skill Workshop, which is a product-boundary decision.

options.title: Close obsolete cluster
options.body: Close this issue and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92126 together, documenting that current main no longer supports `init_skill.py` and Skill Workshop is the supported path.

options.title: Refresh or backport helper repair
options.body: Ask for a refreshed current-main or release/backport PR that intentionally preserves the helper, adds the mixed-case parser coverage, and explains the supported upgrade path.

recommendation.title: Close obsolete cluster
recommendation.body: Close this issue and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92126 together, documenting that current main no longer supports `init_skill.py` and Skill Workshop is the supported path.

likelyOwner.reason: The original bundled skill surface routes most strongly through the commit that added `skill-creator`, making this the best available product-boundary owner from local history.
